territories.name: Mexico
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Mexico levies a value added tax of its own under the Ley del Impuesto al Valor Agregado, whose article 1o. sets the general rate.
